title.value: Produce investment memos with Claude Cowork

introduction.value: The author walks non-developers through using Claude Cowork to produce a full investment memo in about 15 minutes and track the investment afterwards.

method.value: The author gave Claude Cowork access to a local folder and had it build a per-company structure. Using plain prompts, it downloaded Adyen's reports, transcripts and yfinance data, then wrote a business overview, an Excel model with a 3-scenario DCF and comps, a thesis memo and a one-pager. It also set up a weekly scheduled update task and turned the workflow into a reusable skill.

outcome.value: The Adyen workflow finished in under 15 minutes, and the skill later produced an IREN memo and model in a couple of minutes. A commenter said the filing and transcript downloads often fail for other stocks.

notes.value: Data gathering took about 5 minutes, mostly from hunting for transcripts. The weekly task only runs if the computer is on and Claude is open, and the author says to review the plan before running the skill.

source_text.body:
Produce investment memos with Claude Cowork
The author walks non-developers through using Claude Cowork to produce a full investment memo in about 15 minutes and track the investment afterwards.
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
The author gave Claude Cowork access to a local folder and had it build a per-company structure. Using plain prompts, it downloaded Adyen's reports, transcripts and yfinance data, then wrote a business overview, an Excel model with a 3-scenario DCF and comps, a thesis memo and a one-pager. It also set up a weekly scheduled update task and turned the workflow into a reusable skill.
How it went
The Adyen workflow finished in under 15 minutes, and the skill later produced an IREN memo and model in a couple of minutes. A commenter said the filing and transcript downloads often fail for other stocks.
Worth knowing
Data gathering took about 5 minutes, mostly from hunting for transcripts. The weekly task only runs if the computer is on and Claude is open, and the author says to review the plan before running the skill.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Write an investment memo on [company or ticker] for me. Cover the business, recent financials, competitors, key risks, valuation, and a clear buy/hold/pass view, citing the sources you used. Save it as a [Word doc or PDF] in my [folder], and also create a simple tracking sheet with the entry price, my thesis, and the dates and metrics I should review. Stop once both files are saved and give me a short summary.
Original source: https://investwithai.substack.com/p/9-steps-in-claude-cowork-to-automate
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

introduction.en: This entry describes a non-programmer using Claude Cowork to assemble a company research package rather than an audited investment service.
introduction.zh: 此条目描述非程序员用Claude Cowork装配公司研究资料包，并非经审计的投资服务。

method.en: The author let Cowork create per-company folders, then obtain Adyen reports, call transcripts and yfinance data. Outputs included a business overview, an Excel model with three DCF scenarios and comparable-company analysis, a thesis memo and a one-page brief.
method.zh: 作者让Cowork建立各公司文件夹，再收集Adyen报告、电话会文字稿与yfinance数据；输出包括业务概述、含三情景DCF及comps可比公司分析的Excel模型、投资论点备忘录和one-pager单页简报。

method.en: The workflow also defined a weekly monitoring task and became a reusable skill; the source says the plan should be reviewed before that skill runs.
method.zh: 流程还定义每周跟踪任务并整理为可复用技能；源站要求运行技能前先审阅计划。

outcome.en: The reported Adyen run took under fifteen minutes, including roughly five minutes of collection, largely spent locating transcripts. Reusing the skill reportedly produced an IREN memo and model in a few minutes.
outcome.zh: 据述Adyen流程不到十五分钟，其中约五分钟搜集资料，主要用于寻找文字稿；复用技能后，数分钟生成IREN备忘录及模型。

notes.en: A commenter reportedly encountered repeated filing and transcript download failures on other stocks. The tutorial’s weekly task needed the computer and Claude open; that describes its historical setup, not a current availability check. No workbook audit or investment return is supplied.
notes.zh: 据转述，一位评论者在其他股票上反复遇到财报及文字稿下载失败；教程中的周任务要求电脑与Claude开启，这是历史设置而非当前能力核查。源站未提供工作簿审计或投资收益。

translation.body:
用 Claude Cowork 生成投资备忘录
作者向非开发者演示如何使用 Claude Cowork，在约 15 分钟内生成一份完整的投资备忘录，并在之后持续跟踪这项投资。
使用工具
Claude Cowork
具体做法
作者允许 Claude Cowork 访问一个本地文件夹，并让它为每家公司建立文件夹结构。通过普通文字提示，它下载了 Adyen 的报告、电话会议文字稿和 yfinance 数据，随后撰写业务概述、制作包含三种情景的现金流折现估值（DCF）及可比公司分析的 Excel 模型，并生成投资论点备忘录和单页简报。它还设置了每周定时更新任务，并将这套流程整理成可重复使用的技能。
结果如何
Adyen 的整套流程在不到 15 分钟内完成。之后，这项技能又在几分钟内生成了 IREN 的备忘录和模型。一位评论者表示，处理其他股票时，财务申报文件和电话会议文字稿经常下载失败。
值得知道
资料收集用了约 5 分钟，大部分时间花在寻找电话会议文字稿上。每周任务只有在电脑开机且 Claude 已打开时才会运行；作者提醒，运行技能之前应先审阅计划。
自行试用
推荐工具
Claude Cowork
复制提示词
请为我撰写一份关于[公司名称或股票代码]的投资备忘录。内容应涵盖业务、近期财务状况、竞争对手、主要风险、估值，以及明确的买入／持有／不买入意见，并引用你使用的来源。将它以[Word 文档或 PDF]格式保存到我的[文件夹]中，同时创建一份简单的跟踪表，记录买入价格、我的投资理由，以及我应该复查的日期和指标。两个文件都保存后就停止，并给我一份简短总结。
原始来源：https://investwithai.substack.com/p/9-steps-in-claude-cowork-to-automate
